content: It is worth reflecting on the nature of the shared task dataset (PTC corpus) and its structural correspondence (or lack thereof) to some of the definitions of propaganda mentioned in the introduction. First, propaganda is a social phenomenon and takes place as an act of communication BIBREF19, and so it is more than a simple information-theoretic message of zeros and ones—it also incorporates an addresser and addressee(s), each in phatic contact (typically via broadcast media), ideally with a shared denotational code and contextual surround(s) BIBREF20.
